argumentSchema.description:
What a room stores. Each record but `about` has a default, so a space's own
chat starts with none of them.

about.description:
What the room says about itself, written once by the manager that creates
it. A space's own chat has none, and reads as a group room with no title.

participants.description:
Those who joined the room. It changes only through `addParticipant`, the
one writer its write contract admits.

requests.description: The requests the room has acted on.

usedTimes.description: The times the room has recorded something at.

requestId.description:
Chosen by the sender, and unique among its adds. The outcome is recorded
under it, and sending the same event again with it changes nothing. A
rendered control's click carries none, and is given one of its own.

target.description: The control, holding the new member's chat address.

status.description: The person was admitted, or held the access already.

code.description:
Which refusal it is, for a client to act on, where a client has one to
take; absent for the others.

reason.description: Why, for a person to read.

status.description: The add was refused, and nothing was granted.

deleted.description: Always `true`: the marker of a deleted message.

authorProfile.description: The profile the sender sent under; absent once obliterated.

body.description: The current text, or the marker of a deleted message.

earlierVersions.description: The versions before the current one, oldest first.

editedAt.description:
When the room recorded the current version, if it isn't the first: the
latest edit or deletion. Unique in the room.

reactions.description: Everyone's reactions to this message, in no particular order.

replyTo.description: What this message replies to, and where it is shown; absent for none.

sentAt.description: When the room recorded the message's first version. Unique in the room.

count.description: How many messages the room holds, obliterated tombstones included.

latest.description: The newest messages of the main conversation, kept current.

hasOlder.description: Whether the main conversation has older messages than these.

messages.description: Up to `maxWindowCount` of them, oldest first.

newestAt.description: The newest message's `sentAt`; absent while there are none.

oldestAt.description: The oldest message's `sentAt`; absent while there are none.

openWindow.description: Opens a window, or moves one already open.

windows.description: This session's open windows, by the `windowId` its client chose.

sentAt.description:
When the room recorded this version; in a send or an edit, the time the
sender proposes.

hasNewer.description: Whether the view has messages newer than the window's last.

hasOlder.description: Whether the view has messages older than the window's first.

messages.description: The messages in the window, oldest first.

requestId.description: The `openWindow` request that set the window as it is now.

root.description: For a thread's window, the thread's root; absent for the main one.

avatar.description: The person's avatar: a URL or a glyph, if they have set one.

name.description: The person's display name, if they have set one.

reactorProfile.description: The profile the reactor reacted under.

sentAt.description: When the room recorded the reaction. Unique in the room.

message.description: The message replied to, in the same room.

createdAt.description: When the room was created; absent for a space's own chat.

kind.description: `"direct"` if created as a direct room; `"group"` otherwise.

policy.description: The room's policy, stated correctly, in a document of its own.

record.description:
The record the room's creator wrote, whose label names them; absent for a
space's own chat, which no one created as a room.

title.description: A group room's title. A direct room, and a space's own chat, have none.

at.description: When the room recorded it. Unique in the room.

requestId.description: The `requestId` of the event it records.

seq.description: The entry's place in the room's activity: 1, 2, 3, … with no gaps.

what.description: The message the event changed or added.

deletionIsObliteration.description: Whether a sender's deletion of their own message obliterates it.

keepsHistory.description: Whether an edit or a plain deletion keeps the version it replaces.

maxOpenWindows.description: The most message windows a session can have open.

maxWindowCount.description: The most messages a message window holds.

ownersMayObliterate.description: Whether an OWNER may obliterate messages.

proposedTimeMaxAgeNsec.description: How far before the room's clock a proposed time is accepted, in ns.

proposedTimeMaxLeadNsec.description: How far after the room's clock a proposed time is accepted, in ns.

recentActivityWindowNsec.description: How long an entry stays in `recentActivity`, in ns.

about.description: What the room says about itself.

addMember.description:
Admits someone to the room's space, with OWNER, from a trusted gesture on
the rendering's `ChatAddMemberSurface`, or from a client's own control
through the sanctioned issuing path. Only an OWNER of a group room in a
space of its own may admit someone.

addParticipant.description:
Adds a profile to those who joined the room, once. Any participant may add
any profile, so an entry is a claim: it does not say that the profile's
principal holds access to the room's space.

addRequests.description: The outcome of each of this reader's adds, by its `requestId`.

canAdd.description:
Whether this reader can add someone: an OWNER of a group room in a space
of its own.

canSend.description: Whether this reader can send, edit, delete, and react.

deleteMessage.description: Records one of the sender's messages as deleted.

deleteReaction.description: Removes the sender's reaction to a message.

editMessage.description: Records a new version of one of the sender's messages.

obliterateMessage.description: Reduces a message to a tombstone.

participantPrincipals.description:
The principal each of `participants` stands for, as its profile's
`represents-principal` label attests it: each once, in the order of
`participants`, leaving out a profile that attests none, or whose label
can't be read where the list is derived. Like `participants`, it is not
proof of access.

participants.description:
The room's participants: for a room that is its space's root, those who
joined it; for any other, its space's participants as the space's root
lists them, then those who joined the room itself; and then any author
neither lists.

recentActivity.description: What the room recorded recently, in `seq` order.

recentActivityExpiredThrough.description: The highest `seq` dropped from `recentActivity` for age; 0 for none.

sendReaction.description: Adds the sender's reaction to a message.

profile.description: The profile, as the live cell in its own space.

replyTo.description: What this message replies to, and where it is shown.

sentAt.description: When the room recorded the message's first version.

replyTo.description: What a sent message replies to.

requestId.description: Chosen by the sender, and unique among its requests.

version.description: The version to send or record.

count.description: The most messages to show, capped by the room's `maxWindowCount`.

from.description: Where the window sits; required to open one.

requestId.description: Chosen by the client; shown in the window once an open is fulfilled.

root.description: The root of the thread to show; absent for the main conversation.

windowId.description: The window to set or close, chosen by the client.

message.description: The message replied to, in the same room.
